description: Review Bitbucket PRs version by version, despite amend, rebase and force-push, in VS Code
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: In an untrusted workspace, the followed repositories, the followed contributors and the per-repository approvals defined by the workspace are ignored.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: “Open file” needs a repository cloned on disk; everything else works.
configuration.repositories: Bitbucket repositories whose open PRs appear in “My PRs”: one `workspace/repository` (or the repository URL) per entry. Can also be edited from ⚙ Settings in the Revspan panel.
configuration.requiredApprovals: Approvals a PR needs (from participants other than its author) before it leaves your review queue. From 1 to 20, default 2.
configuration.requiredApprovalsByReposit: Required approvals for specific repositories, which replace `revspan.review.requiredApprovals`: `{ "workspace/repository": 3 }`.
configuration.followedContributors: Contributors whose new PRs you want to review: a list of `{ "uuid": "…", "displayName": "…" }`.
configuration.notifications.newPullReque: Notify when a followed contributor, or someone who designated you as a reviewer, opens a PR that needs review.
configuration.notifications.newVersion: Notify when a PR you reviewed or approved receives a new version.
configuration.notifications.buildFailed: Notify when the build of one of your own PRs fails.
configuration.refreshIntervalMinutes: Minutes between two automatic refreshes of “My PRs”, from 1 to 120.
welcome.noToken:
No valid Bitbucket token.
[Set up the token](command:revspan.openSettings)
